Alicia / Team —

Appreciate the quick reply and clear gating list. Two operational notes from our side as we prepare the MAP v1.1 and the security packet:

1) Sponsor stewardship: Ben and I propose the following internal owners to streamline the EB and the evaluation:
   - Exec sponsor (board/CEO level): Laura Bennett — will own the EB agenda and executive follow-ups.
   - Deal sponsor (day-to-day commercial): Ben Carter — owns contract cadence and procurement touchpoints.
   - Technical sponsor (pilot/POC): Marissa Cole — will lead the technical deep-dive and pilot acceptance criteria.

   If you confirm Diego (CEO) as an EB attendee, Laura will coordinate with him directly for the executive goals.

2) EB objective framing: To make the EB 45–60 minutes and productive, we suggest:
   - 10 min: Strategic context & ROI summary (executive sponsor)
   - 25 min: Demo + high-level performance/latency commitments (technical sponsor)
   - 15 min: Commercial/contract/time-to-live (deal sponsor)
   - 10 min: Q&A + next steps (all)

We will update the MAP with those owner roles, explicit dates, and a gating checklist (SOC2 pack, signed NDA/LoA, pilot success metrics). Ben — can you attach the security_questionnaire_filled.pdf and the EB agenda doc in the next send?
